column1: Shohei Ohtani leads the slate with a strong hit probability and a favorable matchup against Brandon Pfaadt, who has allowed consistent contact to lefties. Ohtani’s recent uptick in hits and his spot atop the order add to his reliability. Jordan Walker also stands out, riding a steady run of games with hits and facing a hittable lefty in a hitter-friendly park. Luis Arraez and Freddie Freeman offer additional safety with their consistent approaches and advantageous matchups.
